nomic-embed-text:latest.name: Search Index
nomic-embed-text:latest.description: Not a chat model — pull this once to power the Reference Library's semantic search (the 📚 toggle in chat, and the Library tab's search). Tiny and fast; works regardless of whatever chat model you actually talk to.

qwen3:14b.name: Core Pro
qwen3:14b.description: Newest Qwen generation at 14B — best general quality that still fits 12GB. Tight: keep context under ~8K tokens for comfortable headroom

deepseek-r1:14b.name: Logic Pro
deepseek-r1:14b.description: Deeper reasoning and larger effective context than the 7B distill — for genuinely hard multi-step problems

qwen3-vl:8b.name: Eye Pro
qwen3-vl:8b.description: Handles document OCR, chart reading, and multi-turn image Q&A well — the sweet spot vision model for 12-16GB cards

richardyoung/qwen3-14b-abliterated:q4_K_.name: Unchained Pro
richardyoung/qwen3-14b-abliterated:q4_K_.description: Abliterated Qwen3-14B — noticeably smarter and more coherent than the 8B-class abliterated models while still fitting 12GB

qwen2.5-coder:14b.name: Dev Pro
qwen2.5-coder:14b.description: Meaningful step up from the 7B coder for multi-file context and harder refactors, still comfortable on 12GB

mistral-nemo:12b.name: Muse Pro
mistral-nemo:12b.description: Mistral NeMo 12B (Drummer creative-writing tune) — strong prose and character consistency, with headroom to spare on 12GB

qwen2.5:14b.name: Ranger Pro
qwen2.5:14b.description: No purpose-built survival/homesteading model exists at any size — Qwen2.5-14B is a proven, broad-knowledge alternative to the newer Qwen3 General pick, giving you a second reliable reference model. It's still safety-tuned, though, so it will hedge on some medical/defensive topics — see Ranger+ below for those. Pair with RAG over actual field manuals for grounded, citable answers

hf.co/bartowski/Dolphin3.0-Llama3.1-8B-G.name: Ranger+
hf.co/bartowski/Dolphin3.0-Llama3.1-8B-G.description: No 14B-class Dolphin exists, so this is the same refusal-free 8B pick as the 8GB tier, reused here because it fits a 12GB card with room to spare. Trades knowledge breadth for actually answering — use this one instead of Ranger Pro when the question is something a safety-tuned model would decline (improvised first aid, defensive tactics, off-grid chemistry)
